ticks.note: `for i : buckled` makes one copy per element of `buckled`: `SEATS` is 4, so `i` = 0 to 3. All four lamps are on.
Seats 0 and 2: their copies switch off their own lamp and both add 1 to `fastened`. Concurrent `++` on one variable is fine; the copies write different elements of `lamp`, so they do not conflict.
Seats 1 and 3 finish (`fastened` = 4). Every region of the chart is now final, so the chart itself terminates.
A terminated chart does nothing more.
